::: {#def-dfs-tree}
#### Depth-first search tree

Let $G$ be a connected (@def-connected) graph with no parallel edges (@def-parallel-edges),
given by an adjacency list (@def-adjacency-list), and let $s$ be a vertex of $G$.
By @lem-dfs-one-call, `dfs(G, s)` (@def-dfs) makes exactly one call `dfs(G, u)` on each vertex $u$,
and for $u \ne s$ that call is made by a call `dfs(G, v)` for some vertex $v$.
The **depth-first search tree** of $G$ from $s$ [@wikipedia_depth_first_search]
is the subgraph (@def-subgraph) of $G$ with every vertex of $G$
and, for each vertex $u \ne s$, the edge $\set{v, u}$.

:::
